summary: Comprehensive testing of NIPS-AI Dropshipping Cloud prototype. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed including REAL OpenAI gpt-5.2 calls via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (title/description/tags rewrite). Frontend: All 7 sidebar pages load, exact AliExpress URL capture works (product_id=1005007250240074), import->studio navigation works, all studio tabs render, AI Rewrite dialog appears with non-empty suggestion, Apply updates field, Publish dialog opens and correctly surfaces 400 'already published' as a toast. No critical bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~670 lines and could be split into routers/ submodules (discovery, imports, ai, publish, releases) for maintainability when this grows beyond prototype.
publish_draft uses int(timestamp % 90000) for wc_product_id — possible collisions if two publishes happen in the same second. Use uuid-derived int or DB sequence.
build_draft_from_product copies large product dicts via list()/dict() shallow copies; deep nested attrs/variants share refs across drafts. Use copy.deepcopy for safety.
/api/maintenance/clear uses Query(regex=) which is deprecated in pydantic v2 (should use `pattern=`). Works today but may warn on upgrade.
AI rewrite has no rate-limit/abuse protection — an unauthenticated public endpoint that calls OpenAI is risky beyond prototype.
No backend tests for /api/v1/plugin/releases download flow or supplier-store search mode (search_supplier never reached via /discovery/search auto-detect for non-aliexpress URLs).
Frontend: ProductStudio.jsx ~500 lines — would benefit from extracting Overview/Images/Variants/Description tabs into separate components.
test_credentials: No auth — public API. Mock license key NIPS-ADMIN-LICENSE-0001 shown in UI.
seed_data_creation: Created several test drafts during runs (TEST_ prefixed where applicable). Some drafts persist in MongoDB — main agent can call POST /api/maintenance/clear?target=drafts to reset (published drafts preserved by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 25 critical endpoints incl. real AI rewrites (~5s each). Frontend data-testid coverage is complete: sidebar-nav-*, kpi-*, discovery-input/mode/search-btn, import-btn-{product_id}, draft-card-{id}, open-studio-{id}, studio-title, tab-*, ai-rewrite-{field}, ai-preview-dialog, ai-apply, studio-publish-open, publish-dialog, publish-mode, publish-confirm, publish-done, toggle-*, maint-history/drafts/logs. AI rewrite dialog needs ~3-10s wait after click. Publish on already-published draft returns 400 with toast 'Publish failed - Draft already published' — this is correct behavior, not a bug.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified; all features behave per spec.
